title: Sr System & Cloud Engineer
full_description: The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. Job Summary: What You Need To Know About The Role As a Software Engineer in PayPal’s Public Cloud Engineering team, you will help to build a robust and scalable multi cloud platform to support PayPal to adopt public cloud services from AWS, GCP and Azure to accelerate migration from on premise environment. You will drive innovation in building public cloud environments leveraging your expertise and experience in building systems that further PayPal’s goal of bringing best-in-class customer experience to provide global payment acceptance solutions to all merchant/partner segments at PayPal Meet our team We are the Cloud Centre of Excellence team which enables engineers and developers within PayPal to make use of GCP, AWS and Azure cloud in secure reliable and scalable manner. Our team builds platform, self-service tools and automation using cutting edge cloud native technologies and solutions to reduce friction and enable product teams within PayPal to leverage GCP, AWS and Azure. Job Description: Essential Responsibilities: Oversee load balancers, Global Server Load Balancing (GSLB) equipment, Content Delivery Network (CDN) platforms, and troubleshoot client/server issues. Handle proactive and reactive outages, work with vendors, and take ownership of network incidents, escalations, and root cause analysis. Lead backbone network design and architecture for on-premises and public cloud migration, and build hybrid connectivity solutions. Work with business unit leadership, product managers, and customers to develop project objectives, timelines, and feature requirements. Support network system availability, manage network capacity, and ensure compliance with Information Security standards. Deploy equipment, manage SSL certificate hosting and renewal, and build infrastructure for data centers and cloud environments. Implement and continually improve operational procedures, systems, and network engineering best practices. Offer on-call support, monitor infrastructure and hosted services, and troubleshoot complex issues. Manage and influence global teams, provide guidance and support, and mentor team members in areas of expertise. Communicate incident impacts, risks, and mitigation plans to executives, document incident information, and create network engineering documentation and best practices. Minimum Qualifications: 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience. Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications: Your way to impact: Looking for technically strong candidate, with hands on development experience in both frontend and backend, who is self-motivated, team player, with curiosity to learn and grow, exhibiting strong resolve and challenge the status quo, to strive for excellence in everything they do, with good professional and academic track record to be part of a team that deals with most complex multi cloud environment. In your day-to-day role you will be responsible for: Develops efficient, elegant, clean, reusable code with no unnecessary complication or abstraction. Mentor other engineers and developers by providing technical and business-related guidance and resources; Deliver quality solutions on schedule. Create / Review well-articulated, detailed design documents. Provides recognized technical and business leadership and can provide deep technical support across a range of functionality. Manages workload and other assignments efficiently while being able to resolve time-critical situations reliably and professionally. Participates in the development of tools, systems and processes aimed at improving product supportability or overall support productivity. What do you need to bring: 4-8 years of experience in developing large scale enterprise applications involving frontend and backend Experience in developing intuitive and aesthetically pleasing frontend using javascript/react. Experience in developing backend REST API based services using Golang. Experience in using cloud native services of AWS, GCP and Azure such as cloud functions, pubsub and cloud storage. Experience in infrastructure as code such as Terraform and Google Kubernetes Engine. Experience in writing unit and integration tests for frontend(javascript) and backend(Golang). Good to have knowledge of basic linux commands and shell scripting. Good to have knowledge in continuous delivery and continuous integration tools such as Jenkins, Harness, ArgoCD. Strong debugging, troubleshooting and problem resolution skills. Believes in Agile development and are comfortable with SCRUM processes. full_description: Description Principal Azure Cloud Platform Engineer - Databricks & CI/CD Pipelines Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress. Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support. Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know: Why Syneos Health We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program. We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life. We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress. Job Responsibilities Position Overview: We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Principal Azure Cloud Engineer to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of Azure-based cloud solutions, with a focus on data solutions, infrastructure automation, and migration. The ideal candidate will possess a strong technical background in cloud architecture, especially in building Infrastructure as Code (IaC), designing scalable Azure Data Lake and database solutions, and driving migration strategies. As a technical leader, you will guide cross-functional teams to ensure that our cloud architecture aligns with business goals, follows best practices, and optimizes performance, security, and compliance. Key Responsibilities: Technical Leadership & Strategic Guidance: Provide technical leadership and mentorship to cross-functional teams (cloud engineers, data engineers, business stakeholders) to architect robust Azure-based data solutions. Ensure alignment of cloud solutions with business objectives, considering current and future growth. Stay updated with the latest Azure innovations, trends, and best practices to recommend the best solutions for complex business needs. Azure Data Lake and Database Solutions: Design and deploy scalable and high-performance Azure Data Lake storage solutions to handle large volumes of unstructured and structured data. Architect, configure, and manage Azure SQL Database, Cosmos DB, and other database offerings to ensure high availability, disaster recovery, and optimized performance. Databricks Administration & Integration: Manage, configure, and administer Azure Databricks environments, ensuring optimal performance, scalability, and security of data processing workloads. Collaborate with data scientists, data engineers, and analysts to integrate Azure Databricks with other Azure services (e.g., Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse) to build scalable data processing and analytics solutions. Implement best practices for managing Databricks clusters, notebooks, libraries, and jobs to ensure efficiency and cost optimization. Perform regular monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance tuning of Databricks workloads, ensuring high reliability and uptime. Cloud Migration Strategy & Execution: Develop and implement comprehensive strategies for migrating on-premises data and applications to Azure with minimal disruption to business operations. Use Azure-native tools (e.g., Azure Migrate, Data Migration Assistant) to facilitate seamless migration of data assets to the cloud. Azure Data Factory (ADF) Expertise: Design, implement, and maintain efficient data pipelines using Azure Data Factory(ADF) to orchestrate and automate ETL workflows across various data sources and destinations. Optimize pipeline performance, manage dependencies, and ensure seamless data movement across hybrid cloud environments. Database Services Optimization: Administer and optimize Azure Database offerings such as Azure SQL Database, SQL Managed Instances, and other relational/non-relational databases. Design high-availability, fault-tolerant architectures, and ensure efficient data replication, backup, and recovery. Performance Tuning & Optimization: Identify and address performance bottlenecks within Azure-based data solutions, applying performance tuning strategies to maximize system efficiency. Ensure that systems are optimized for cost efficiency, scalability, and reliability by monitoring usage patterns and implementing proactive optimization strategies. Security & Compliance: Implement strong security measures across Azure data solutions to ensure confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data. Leverage Azure's security features, including encryption, role-based access control(RBAC), firewalls, and auditing tools to meet compliance requirements (e.g., GDPR,HIPAA, SOC 2). Conduct regular security assessments and work with teams to enforce security best practices across all cloud solutions. Collaboration & Communication: Engage with stakeholders from business units, IT, and data engineering to understand business requirements, design appropriate solutions, and ensure smooth project delivery. Present project updates, technical challenges, and solutions to executive leadership and other stakeholders, ensuring transparency and alignment with organizational goals. Facilitate collaborative decision-making and knowledge sharing among cross-functional teams to achieve optimal solutions. Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Lead the design and implementation of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using tools like Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates, Terraform, or Azure Bicep to automate infrastructure provisioning and management. Ensure that IaC practices are embedded in the development lifecycle for consistent, repeatable, and scalable cloud deployments. Qualifications: Experience: 8+ years in cloud architecture, with at least 4 years focused on Azure cloud solutions and architecture design. Technical Skills: Expertise in Azure Data Lake, Azure SQL Database, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure SQL Managed Instance, and related Azure data services. Strong proficiency in Azure Data Factory (ADF) for data pipeline orchestration and ETL process design. Databricks administration and optimization experience, including clustermanagement, job execution, and integration with Azure services. Solid experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools like Terraform, ARM templates, or Azure Bicep. Familiarity with Azure Databricks, and other advanced data processing services. title: Staff Database Reliability Engineer
full_description: Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world! Automation Architecture Designs reusable Python automation, observability, validation, and lifecycle-management patterns rather than isolated scripts. Execution Drives ambiguous initiatives from problem framing through design, alignment, implementation guidance, and measurable outcomes. Organizational Influence Influences multiple engineering groups through data, production evidence, design standards, and technical judgment; does not unilaterally set enterprise strategy. Key Responsibilities OpenSearch Platform Architecture Design and improve large-scale OpenSearch/Elasticsearch topology, dedicated node roles, shard and index strategies, lifecycle management, workload distribution, and recovery patterns. Solve complex indexing, search, cluster-state, JVM/GC, storage, segment, mapping, allocation, and cross-cluster reliability problems. Establish domain-level resilience, snapshot, replication, upgrade, and capacity patterns appropriate to the actual scale of the environment. Kafka and Redis Reliability Guide Kafka topology, partitioning, replication, capacity, consumer reliability, and failure-mode remediation for critical services. Guide Redis Cluster and Sentinel architecture, memory and eviction behavior, persistence tradeoffs, failover, re-sharding, and client reliability. Automation, Observability, and Capacity Engineering Architect reusable Python tooling and safe remediation frameworks for provisioning, validation, maintenance, scaling, and incident prevention. Define domain-level observability, SLIs/SLOs, capacity models, lifecycle forecasts, and actionable risk thresholds. Establish Infrastructure-as-Code and operator patterns where they improve repeatability and supportability. Technical Strategy and Cross-Team Leadership Lead architecture and production-readiness reviews for the data-platform domain. Evaluate emerging technologies through workload-relevant benchmarks, failure testing, operability reviews, and total-cost considerations. Lead complex technical investigations and systemic corrective actions; mentor engineers and improve engineering practices across teams. Required Qualifications and Experience 8+ years of DBRE, SRE, database, or distributed data-platform engineering experience with Staff, Lead, or comparable technical leadership scope. Deep hands-on mastery of OpenSearch and/or Elasticsearch internals, operations, performance, lifecycle management, recovery, and architecture. Strong production experience with Kafka and/or Redis, with the ability to reason across distributed data-platform failure modes. Strong systems expertise across JVM, Linux, CPU, memory, storage I/O, networking, and capacity behavior. Strong Python software-engineering capability for reusable production automation and tooling. Demonstrated success solving ambiguous cross-team technical problems and influencing architecture through evidence and judgment. Kubernetes operators, Terraform, Ansible, GitOps, and cloud-managed data services. Experience evaluating ClickHouse, Pinot, vector databases, or stream-processing technologies. Experience with chaos testing, production-readiness reviews, and cost-aware capacity engineering. Deliver reusable automation and observability patterns that reduce systemic toil and improve safe execution across teams. Publish and drive adoption of domain-level architecture, production-readiness, capacity, and resilience standards. Resolve one or more high-impact systemic risks and develop a prioritized multi-quarter improvement roadmap for the data-platform domain. This role does not unilaterally define enterprise-wide cross-domain architecture or approval policy; that scope belongs to Principal-level and executive governance.
